rtr.text: Domri Rade, a young member of the Gruul, dreads the coming Burying, the rite in which Sabast tells him the false Domri must die and the real one be born.

Buried in the ceremonial grave, he is isolated in the dark and begs the Old Gods for deliverance, until in a panic his spark ignites and he planeswalks for the first time, seeing the Blind Eternities.
He wakes in a primordial rainforest, where elves pull him into a cave away from a huge creature, and then, thinking of the Rubblebelt, he planeswalks back to Ravnica.
Expecting banishment, Domri is instead told by Sabast that the Gruul have no laws but those of the wild, and Domri embraces him.

gtc.text: Domri Rade, orphaned on Ravnica and too small for any Gruul clan to claim him, befriends feral beasts.
He commands ragebeasts to drive the Orzhov out of the Rubblebelt, and Borborygmos makes him an honorary Burning Tree member.

Buried alive in the Gruul rite of passage at Utvara, he panics and his eyes are opened, and he wakes on Naya where he is nearly killed by a Gargantuan, is saved by Cylian godtrackers and returns home through the Blind Eternities.
